meta.title: Smartwatch bridge (dsh-watch-draft)
meta.description: HTTP bridge that lets a smartwatch (Xiaomi Watch 5 / WearOS) chat with DSH over LAN with voice input. Exposes GET /health and POST /chat on a configurable port (default 38400). The watch app does on-device speech-to-text and sends text to /chat; DSH replies with the assistant's answer.
